design.label: s = 12 * (u-1/2) * (v-1/2); u = xs pct rank of engine prediction, v = xs pct rank of excess_vw_1m; the xs MEAN of s is the month's Spearman rank IC
design.walk_forward: expanding, annual refit, first test year 2017, purge/embargo 2 months
design.book: top-50 value-weighted, 10.0 bps/side on measured weight turnover, both sides
design.abstention: the n lowest-router-score slots of the top-k hold the market instead; the market slot is a real instrument and pays the spread on entry and exit

engine_choice.note: chosen on the ROUTER'S TRAINING window only, so the primary cell does not inherit a full-sample look

family.note: every cell LOOKED AT is charged (invariant 16). Holm for export, BH-FDR at q=0.10 for screening.

dsr_vs_family.variance_source: variance of the family's own Sharpes

null_random_abstention.asks: does moving 30% of the book to the market -- ANY 30% -- do this?

null_shuffled_labels.asks: a router trained on labels permuted within the date block must produce no gain

trap_size_vol_coverage.asks: regress the router score on size, volatility, coverage and dollar volume; what is left, and does it still route?
